assetCollections.name: Bill's OO Gauge Collection
assetCollections.description: OO gauge model railway collection started in 1985. Mostly Hornby with Bachmann, Heljan, and Dapol. Layout stored in the loft at Oakfield Road, Flint Mountain.
assetCollections.disposalWishes: Keep the collection together if possible. Contact Dave at Manchester Model Railway Club — he knows the right dealers. Do not sell on eBay individually.
assetCollections.specialistDealerNotes: Rails of Sheffield (01onal@railsofsheffield.com) — largest UK model railway dealer. Hattons of Liverpool — strong on Bachmann and Hornby. Avoid eBay 'lot sellers' — they undervalue specialist items.

legacyContacts.name: Paul Frith
legacyContacts.notes: Letter is in the sideboard drawer in the living room.

recommendedActions.title: Get dealer valuation for the collection
recommendedActions.description: The collection is self-estimated at £555. A specialist dealer valuation would provide a more accurate figure for insurance and for Paul.

recommendedActions.title: Add photographs of key items
recommendedActions.description: No images are attached to any items. Photographs significantly increase dealer confidence and comparable matching accuracy.
